title: Signature Terraced Sky Garden Tower
body:
Signature Terraced Sky Garden Tower is an original Signature tower type in which every fourth floor steps back to form a planted terrace, so the tower reads as a stack of gardens rather than a sheer wall. Its Signature feature is a shared garden level at each setback, open to all residents of the floors it serves.

This is an original Signature design, labelled Signature, and it is not presented as an established fact or as an existing product. It is a complete design record: what the design is, how it works, and what makes it distinct, with a working demo program that models one measurable aspect of it.
